title: Once Correct, Still Wrong: Counterfactual Hallucination in Multilingual Vision-Language Models
reasoning: The paper introduces the M2CQA benchmark, which specifically evaluates model performance across 12 semantic categories, including 'Religion, Culture & National Identity'. The benchmark tests whether vision-language models can correctly identify and reason about religious buildings (like mosques), religious attire (like the abaya), and religious ceremonies within the MENA context, rather than hallucinating based on cultural priors.
